segments.tr: À medida que o final do verão dá lugar ao outono, os locais de armazenamento de gás natural da Europa estão no seu nível sazonal mais baixo em cerca de 17 anos, de acordo com rastreadores da indústria que monitoram os estoques em toda a União Europeia.

segments.src: For a continent that has spent the past few winters rebuilding confidence in its energy security after the shock of reduced Russian pipeline flows, the shortfall is a reminder that the underlying vulnerabilities in the system have not fully disappeared — they have simply shifted.
segments.tr: Para um continente que passou os últimos invernos reconstruindo a confiança na sua segurança energética após o choque da redução dos fluxos de gasodutos russos, o déficit é um lembrete de que as vulnerabilidades subjacentes no sistema não desapareceram totalmente — elas simplesmente mudaram.

segments.src: This year's culprit looks different from the last.
segments.tr: O culpado deste ano parece diferente do anterior.

segments.src: Analysts point to disruptions linked to tensions involving Iran, which have complicated tanker traffic through the Strait of Hormuz — the narrow waterway that a large share of the world's liquefied natural gas (LNG), including cargoes from Qatar, must pass through on the way to global markets.
segments.tr: Analistas apontam para interrupções ligadas a tensões envolvendo o Irã, que complicaram o tráfego de navios-tanque através do Estreito de Ormuz — a estreita via navegável pela qual uma grande parte do gás natural liquefeito (GNL) do mundo, incluindo cargas do Catar, deve passar a caminho dos mercados globais.

segments.src: When shipments through that chokepoint slow down or reroute, the ripple effects are felt far beyond the Middle East, including in the European ports that have come to rely on LNG as a substitute for pipeline gas.
segments.tr: Quando os embarques através desse ponto de estrangulamento diminuem ou são redirecionados, os efeitos cascata são sentidos muito além do Oriente Médio, inclusive nos portos europeus que passaram a depender do GNL como substituto para o gás de gasoduto.

segments.src: ## Why Storage Levels Matter So Much
segments.tr: ## Por que os Níveis de Armazenamento Importam Tanto

segments.src: Gas storage acts as Europe's shock absorber.
segments.tr: O armazenamento de gás atua como o amortecedor de choque da Europa.

segments.src: Utilities and industrial buyers inject gas into underground reservoirs during the warmer months, when demand is lower, and draw it down during the cold season when heating needs spike.
segments.tr: Empresas de serviços públicos e compradores industriais injetam gás em reservatórios subterrâneos durante os meses mais quentes, quando a demanda é menor, e retiram-no durante a estação fria, quando as necessidades de aquecimento aumentam.

segments.src: A healthy storage cushion going into winter gives grid operators room to manage price swings and supply hiccups without resorting to emergency measures.
segments.tr: Uma reserva de armazenamento saudável antes do inverno dá aos operadores da rede espaço para gerenciar oscilações de preços e problemas de fornecimento sem recorrer a medidas de emergência.

segments.src: When storage starts the season already depleted, that cushion shrinks.
segments.tr: Quando o armazenamento começa a estação já esgotado, essa reserva diminui.

segments.src: Analysts note that a shortfall at this stage of the year does not guarantee a crisis — but it does reduce the margin for error.
segments.tr: Analistas observam que um déficit nesta fase do ano não garante uma crise — mas reduz a margem de erro.

segments.src: A colder-than-average winter, a further disruption to LNG supply routes, or even a spell of low wind power generation could each add pressure on prices and availability at the same time.
segments.tr: Um inverno mais frio que a média, uma nova interrupção nas rotas de fornecimento de GNL ou até mesmo um período de baixa geração de energia eólica poderiam, cada um, aumentar a pressão sobre os preços e a disponibilidade ao mesmo tempo.

segments.src: ## Officials Are Betting on Mild Weather
segments.tr: ## Autoridades Estão Apostando no Clima Ameno

segments.src: According to reports from European energy officials, the current strategy leans heavily on hope for a mild winter.
segments.tr: De acordo com relatórios de autoridades energéticas europeias, a estratégia atual baseia-se fortemente na esperança de um inverno ameno.

segments.src: Government agencies and grid operators across the bloc have reportedly been reviewing contingency plans that include:
segments.tr: Agências governamentais e operadores de rede em todo o bloco teriam revisado planos de contingência que incluem:

segments.src: - Encouraging voluntary demand reduction among large industrial gas users
segments.tr: - Incentivar a redução voluntária da demanda entre grandes usuários industriais de gás

segments.src: - Coordinating LNG import scheduling between member states to smooth out supply gaps
segments.tr: - Coordenar o agendamento de importação de GNL entre os estados membros para suavizar as lacunas de fornecimento

segments.src: - Monitoring the option of temporary industrial curtailments as a last-resort measure if reserves fall too low during a cold snap
segments.tr: - Monitorar a opção de cortes industriais temporários como medida de último recurso caso as reservas caiam muito durante uma onda de frio

segments.src: Energy ministers have generally avoided alarmist language, framing the situation as manageable rather than a repeat of the acute crisis seen a few years ago, when Europe scrambled to replace a much larger share of its gas supply almost overnight.
segments.tr: Os ministros da energia geralmente evitaram uma linguagem alarmista, enquadrando a situação como gerenciável em vez de uma repetição da crise aguda vista há alguns anos, quando a Europa lutou para substituir uma parcela muito maior do seu fornecimento de gás quase da noite para o dia.

segments.src: Still, the underlying message from market watchers is consistent: the buffer is thinner this year, and the outcome may hinge as much on the weather as on policy.
segments.tr: Ainda assim, a mensagem subjacente dos observadores do mercado é consistente: o amortecedor está mais fino este ano, e o resultado pode depender tanto do clima quanto da política.

segments.src: ## What It Could Mean for Households and Businesses
segments.tr: ## O que Isso Pode Significar para Famílias e Empresas

segments.src: For consumers, the most immediate concern is price.
segments.tr: Para os consumidores, a preocupação mais imediata é o preço.

segments.src: Tighter storage levels heading into the withdrawal season tend to make wholesale gas markets more sensitive to news, meaning prices can swing more sharply on reports of supply disruptions or cold weather forecasts.
segments.tr: Níveis de armazenamento mais apertados antes da temporada de retirada tendem a tornar os mercados atacadistas de gás mais sensíveis a notícias, o que significa que os preços podem oscilar mais bruscamente com relatos de interrupções no fornecimento ou previsões de clima frio.

segments.src: Businesses that rely heavily on natural gas — chemical manufacturers, fertilizer producers, and other energy-intensive industries — are watching most closely, since they are typically first in line for any curtailment requests if supply gets tight.
segments.tr: Empresas que dependem fortemente de gás natural — fabricantes de produtos químicos, produtores de fertilizantes e outras indústrias intensivas em energia — estão observando mais de perto, já que geralmente são as primeiras da fila para quaisquer pedidos de corte se o fornecimento ficar apertado.

segments.src: Households, meanwhile, are less likely to face direct rationing, as residential heating is usually prioritized in emergency planning across EU member states.
segments.tr: As famílias, por outro lado, têm menos probabilidade de enfrentar racionamento direto, já que o aquecimento residencial é geralmente priorizado no planejamento de emergência em todos os estados membros da UE.

segments.src: The bigger risk for ordinary consumers is indirect: higher energy bills passed through from wholesale markets, and potential knock-on effects on goods and services produced by gas-intensive industries.
segments.tr: O maior risco para os consumidores comuns é indireto: contas de energia mais altas repassadas dos mercados atacadistas e possíveis efeitos colaterais em bens e serviços produzidos por indústrias intensivas em gás.

segments.src: ## The Months Ahead
segments.tr: ## Os Meses à Frente

segments.src: With storage levels below their typical seasonal average, the coming weeks of autumn will be closely watched as a final opportunity to top up reserves before demand rises.
segments.tr: Com os níveis de armazenamento abaixo da média sazonal típica, as próximas semanas de outono serão observadas de perto como uma oportunidade final para completar as reservas antes que a demanda aumente.

segments.src: Much will depend on factors outside Europe's direct control — including how tensions around the Strait of Hormuz evolve and whether alternative LNG supplies from other exporting regions can help offset any shortfall.
segments.tr: Muito dependerá de fatores fora do controle direto da Europa — incluindo como as tensões em torno do Estreito de Ormuz evoluirão e se suprimentos alternativos de GNL de outras regiões exportadoras podem ajudar a compensar qualquer déficit.

segments.src: For now, the situation is best described as a calculated risk rather than a certain crisis: European officials are wagering that a combination of diversified supply, demand management, and, crucially, favorable weather will be enough to get the continent through winter without resorting to the kind of emergency measures seen in past energy shocks.
segments.tr: Por enquanto, a situação é melhor descrita como um risco calculado em vez de uma crise certa: as autoridades europeias estão apostando que uma combinação de fornecimento diversificado, gestão da demanda e, crucialmente, clima favorável será suficiente para levar o continente através do inverno sem recorrer ao tipo de medidas de emergência vistas em choques energéticos passados.

in.title: Titik Terendah dalam 17 Tahun: Mengapa Eropa Berpacu Mengisi Tangki Gas Sebelum Musim Dingin Tiba

segments.src: ## A Storage Squeeze Not Seen in Nearly Two Decades
segments.tr: ## Krisis Penyimpanan yang Belum Pernah Terjadi dalam Hampir Dua Dekade

segments.src: As late summer gives way to autumn, Europe's natural gas storage sites are sitting at their lowest seasonal level in roughly 17 years, according to industry trackers that monitor inventories across the European Union.
segments.tr: Saat akhir musim panas berganti menjadi musim gugur, situs penyimpanan gas alam Eropa berada pada tingkat musiman terendah dalam sekitar 17 tahun, menurut pelacak industri yang memantau inventaris di seluruh Uni Eropa.

segments.src: For a continent that has spent the past few winters rebuilding confidence in its energy security after the shock of reduced Russian pipeline flows, the shortfall is a reminder that the underlying vulnerabilities in the system have not fully disappeared — they have simply shifted.
segments.tr: Bagi benua yang telah menghabiskan beberapa musim dingin terakhir untuk membangun kembali kepercayaan pada ketahanan energinya setelah guncangan akibat berkurangnya aliran pipa gas Rusia, kekurangan ini menjadi pengingat bahwa kerentanan mendasar dalam sistem belum sepenuhnya hilang — kerentanan tersebut hanya bergeser.

segments.src: This year's culprit looks different from the last.
segments.tr: Penyebab tahun ini terlihat berbeda dari tahun sebelumnya.

segments.src: Analysts point to disruptions linked to tensions involving Iran, which have complicated tanker traffic through the Strait of Hormuz — the narrow waterway that a large share of the world's liquefied natural gas (LNG), including cargoes from Qatar, must pass through on the way to global markets.
segments.tr: Para analis menunjuk pada gangguan yang terkait dengan ketegangan yang melibatkan Iran, yang telah mempersulit lalu lintas kapal tanker melalui Selat Hormuz — jalur air sempit yang harus dilalui oleh sebagian besar gas alam cair (LNG) dunia, termasuk kargo dari Qatar, dalam perjalanan menuju pasar global.

segments.src: When shipments through that chokepoint slow down or reroute, the ripple effects are felt far beyond the Middle East, including in the European ports that have come to rely on LNG as a substitute for pipeline gas.
segments.tr: Ketika pengiriman melalui titik hambatan tersebut melambat atau dialihkan, efek riaknya terasa jauh melampaui Timur Tengah, termasuk di pelabuhan-pelabuhan Eropa yang kini bergantung pada LNG sebagai pengganti gas pipa.

segments.src: ## Why Storage Levels Matter So Much
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Tingkat Penyimpanan Sangat Penting

segments.src: Gas storage acts as Europe's shock absorber.
segments.tr: Penyimpanan gas bertindak sebagai peredam kejut bagi Eropa.

segments.src: Utilities and industrial buyers inject gas into underground reservoirs during the warmer months, when demand is lower, and draw it down during the cold season when heating needs spike.
segments.tr: Perusahaan utilitas dan pembeli industri menyuntikkan gas ke dalam reservoir bawah tanah selama bulan-bulan yang lebih hangat, ketika permintaan lebih rendah, dan menariknya keluar selama musim dingin ketika kebutuhan pemanas melonjak.

segments.src: A healthy storage cushion going into winter gives grid operators room to manage price swings and supply hiccups without resorting to emergency measures.
segments.tr: Bantalan penyimpanan yang sehat menjelang musim dingin memberi operator jaringan ruang untuk mengelola fluktuasi harga dan gangguan pasokan tanpa harus menggunakan langkah-langkah darurat.

segments.src: When storage starts the season already depleted, that cushion shrinks.
segments.tr: Ketika penyimpanan memulai musim dalam keadaan sudah menipis, bantalan tersebut menyusut.

segments.src: Analysts note that a shortfall at this stage of the year does not guarantee a crisis — but it does reduce the margin for error.
segments.tr: Para analis mencatat bahwa kekurangan pada tahap tahun ini tidak menjamin terjadinya krisis — tetapi hal itu mengurangi margin untuk kesalahan.

segments.src: A colder-than-average winter, a further disruption to LNG supply routes, or even a spell of low wind power generation could each add pressure on prices and availability at the same time.
segments.tr: Musim dingin yang lebih dingin dari rata-rata, gangguan lebih lanjut pada rute pasokan LNG, atau bahkan periode pembangkitan tenaga angin yang rendah, masing-masing dapat menambah tekanan pada harga dan ketersediaan pada saat yang bersamaan.

segments.src: ## Officials Are Betting on Mild Weather
segments.tr: ## Para Pejabat Bertaruh pada Cuaca yang Ringan

segments.src: According to reports from European energy officials, the current strategy leans heavily on hope for a mild winter.
segments.tr: Menurut laporan dari pejabat energi Eropa, strategi saat ini sangat bergantung pada harapan akan musim dingin yang ringan.

segments.src: Government agencies and grid operators across the bloc have reportedly been reviewing contingency plans that include:
segments.tr: Badan pemerintah dan operator jaringan di seluruh blok dilaporkan telah meninjau rencana darurat yang mencakup:

segments.src: - Encouraging voluntary demand reduction among large industrial gas users
segments.tr: - Mendorong pengurangan permintaan secara sukarela di kalangan pengguna gas industri besar

segments.src: - Coordinating LNG import scheduling between member states to smooth out supply gaps
segments.tr: - Mengoordinasikan penjadwalan impor LNG antar negara anggota untuk mengatasi kesenjangan pasokan

segments.src: - Monitoring the option of temporary industrial curtailments as a last-resort measure if reserves fall too low during a cold snap
segments.tr: - Memantau opsi pengurangan industri sementara sebagai langkah terakhir jika cadangan turun terlalu rendah selama cuaca dingin ekstrem

segments.src: Energy ministers have generally avoided alarmist language, framing the situation as manageable rather than a repeat of the acute crisis seen a few years ago, when Europe scrambled to replace a much larger share of its gas supply almost overnight.
segments.tr: Para menteri energi umumnya menghindari bahasa yang bernada alarmis, membingkai situasi ini sebagai sesuatu yang dapat dikelola daripada pengulangan krisis akut yang terlihat beberapa tahun lalu, ketika Eropa berjuang untuk mengganti sebagian besar pasokan gasnya hampir dalam semalam.

segments.src: Still, the underlying message from market watchers is consistent: the buffer is thinner this year, and the outcome may hinge as much on the weather as on policy.
segments.tr: Namun, pesan mendasar dari para pengamat pasar tetap konsisten: penyangga tahun ini lebih tipis, dan hasilnya mungkin sangat bergantung pada cuaca seperti halnya pada kebijakan.

segments.src: ## What It Could Mean for Households and Businesses
segments.tr: ## Apa Artinya bagi Rumah Tangga dan Bisnis

segments.src: For consumers, the most immediate concern is price.
segments.tr: Bagi konsumen, kekhawatiran yang paling mendesak adalah harga.

segments.src: Tighter storage levels heading into the withdrawal season tend to make wholesale gas markets more sensitive to news, meaning prices can swing more sharply on reports of supply disruptions or cold weather forecasts.
segments.tr: Tingkat penyimpanan yang lebih ketat menjelang musim penarikan cenderung membuat pasar gas grosir lebih sensitif terhadap berita, yang berarti harga dapat berfluktuasi lebih tajam karena laporan gangguan pasokan atau prakiraan cuaca dingin.

segments.src: Businesses that rely heavily on natural gas — chemical manufacturers, fertilizer producers, and other energy-intensive industries — are watching most closely, since they are typically first in line for any curtailment requests if supply gets tight.
segments.tr: Bisnis yang sangat bergantung pada gas alam — produsen bahan kimia, produsen pupuk, dan industri intensif energi lainnya — adalah yang paling memperhatikan, karena mereka biasanya menjadi yang pertama dalam antrean untuk setiap permintaan pengurangan jika pasokan menjadi ketat.

segments.src: Households, meanwhile, are less likely to face direct rationing, as residential heating is usually prioritized in emergency planning across EU member states.
segments.tr: Sementara itu, rumah tangga cenderung tidak menghadapi penjatahan langsung, karena pemanas perumahan biasanya diprioritaskan dalam perencanaan darurat di seluruh negara anggota UE.

segments.src: The bigger risk for ordinary consumers is indirect: higher energy bills passed through from wholesale markets, and potential knock-on effects on goods and services produced by gas-intensive industries.
segments.tr: Risiko yang lebih besar bagi konsumen biasa adalah tidak langsung: tagihan energi yang lebih tinggi yang diteruskan dari pasar grosir, dan potensi dampak lanjutan pada barang dan jasa yang diproduksi oleh industri intensif gas.

segments.src: ## The Months Ahead
segments.tr: ## Bulan-bulan Mendatang

segments.src: With storage levels below their typical seasonal average, the coming weeks of autumn will be closely watched as a final opportunity to top up reserves before demand rises.
segments.tr: Dengan tingkat penyimpanan di bawah rata-rata musiman biasanya, minggu-minggu mendatang di musim gugur akan diawasi dengan ketat sebagai kesempatan terakhir untuk menambah cadangan sebelum permintaan meningkat.

segments.src: Much will depend on factors outside Europe's direct control — including how tensions around the Strait of Hormuz evolve and whether alternative LNG supplies from other exporting regions can help offset any shortfall.
segments.tr: Banyak hal akan bergantung pada faktor-faktor di luar kendali langsung Eropa — termasuk bagaimana ketegangan di sekitar Selat Hormuz berkembang dan apakah pasokan LNG alternatif dari wilayah pengekspor lain dapat membantu menutupi kekurangan apa pun.

segments.src: For now, the situation is best described as a calculated risk rather than a certain crisis: European officials are wagering that a combination of diversified supply, demand management, and, crucially, favorable weather will be enough to get the continent through winter without resorting to the kind of emergency measures seen in past energy shocks.
segments.tr: Untuk saat ini, situasi ini paling baik digambarkan sebagai risiko yang diperhitungkan daripada krisis yang pasti: para pejabat Eropa bertaruh bahwa kombinasi dari diversifikasi pasokan, manajemen permintaan, dan yang terpenting, cuaca yang mendukung akan cukup untuk membuat benua tersebut melewati musim dingin tanpa harus menggunakan langkah-langkah darurat seperti yang terlihat pada guncangan energi di masa lalu.

ja.title: 17年ぶりの低水準：冬を前に欧州がガス備蓄を急ぐ理由

segments.src: ## A Storage Squeeze Not Seen in Nearly Two Decades
segments.tr: ## 過去20年近く見られなかった備蓄の逼迫

segments.src: As late summer gives way to autumn, Europe's natural gas storage sites are sitting at their lowest seasonal level in roughly 17 years, according to industry trackers that monitor inventories across the European Union.
segments.tr: 欧州連合（EU）全域の在庫を監視する業界トラッカーによると、夏の終わりから秋にかけて、欧州の天然ガス貯蔵施設は過去約17年間で最も低い季節的水準にあるという。

segments.src: For a continent that has spent the past few winters rebuilding confidence in its energy security after the shock of reduced Russian pipeline flows, the shortfall is a reminder that the underlying vulnerabilities in the system have not fully disappeared — they have simply shifted.
segments.tr: ロシアからのパイプライン供給減少というショックを経て、過去数冬にわたりエネルギー安全保障への信頼を再構築してきた欧州大陸にとって、この不足は、システムの根本的な脆弱性が完全には消えておらず、単に形を変えただけであることを思い起こさせるものとなっている。

segments.src: This year's culprit looks different from the last.
segments.tr: 今年の原因は昨年とは異なっているようだ。

segments.src: Analysts point to disruptions linked to tensions involving Iran, which have complicated tanker traffic through the Strait of Hormuz — the narrow waterway that a large share of the world's liquefied natural gas (LNG), including cargoes from Qatar, must pass through on the way to global markets.
segments.tr: アナリストは、イランをめぐる緊張に関連した混乱を指摘している。この緊張が、カタールからの貨物を含む世界の液化天然ガス（LNG）の大部分が世界市場へ向かう際に通過しなければならない狭い水路であるホルムズ海峡を通るタンカーの交通を複雑にしているためだ。

segments.src: When shipments through that chokepoint slow down or reroute, the ripple effects are felt far beyond the Middle East, including in the European ports that have come to rely on LNG as a substitute for pipeline gas.
segments.tr: そのチョークポイント（要衝）を通る輸送が遅延したりルート変更を余儀なくされたりすると、その波及効果は中東をはるかに超えて、パイプラインガスの代替としてLNGに依存するようになった欧州の港湾にまで及ぶ。

segments.src: ## Why Storage Levels Matter So Much
segments.tr: ## なぜ備蓄水準がこれほど重要なのか

segments.src: Gas storage acts as Europe's shock absorber.
segments.tr: ガス備蓄は欧州のショックアブソーバー（緩衝材）として機能している。

segments.src: Utilities and industrial buyers inject gas into underground reservoirs during the warmer months, when demand is lower, and draw it down during the cold season when heating needs spike.
segments.tr: 公益事業会社や産業界のバイヤーは、需要が低い暖かい時期に地下の貯蔵施設へガスを注入し、暖房需要が急増する寒い時期にそれを取り出す。

segments.src: A healthy storage cushion going into winter gives grid operators room to manage price swings and supply hiccups without resorting to emergency measures.
segments.tr: 冬を迎えるにあたって健全な備蓄のクッションがあれば、送電網運営者は緊急措置に頼ることなく、価格変動や供給の不具合を管理する余地が生まれる。

segments.src: When storage starts the season already depleted, that cushion shrinks.
segments.tr: シーズン開始時に備蓄がすでに枯渇していると、そのクッションは縮小してしまう。

segments.src: Analysts note that a shortfall at this stage of the year does not guarantee a crisis — but it does reduce the margin for error.
segments.tr: アナリストは、この時期の不足が直ちに危機を保証するものではないが、許容範囲（マージン）を狭めることにはなると指摘している。

segments.src: A colder-than-average winter, a further disruption to LNG supply routes, or even a spell of low wind power generation could each add pressure on prices and availability at the same time.
segments.tr: 平年より寒い冬、LNG供給ルートのさらなる混乱、あるいは風力発電の低迷などが重なれば、価格と供給可能性に同時に圧力がかかる可能性がある。

segments.src: ## Officials Are Betting on Mild Weather
segments.tr: ## 当局は穏やかな天候に賭けている

segments.src: According to reports from European energy officials, the current strategy leans heavily on hope for a mild winter.
segments.tr: 欧州のエネルギー当局からの報告によると、現在の戦略は穏やかな冬への期待に大きく依存している。

segments.src: Government agencies and grid operators across the bloc have reportedly been reviewing contingency plans that include:
segments.tr: EU全域の政府機関や送電網運営者は、以下のような緊急時対応計画を検討していると報じられている：

segments.src: - Encouraging voluntary demand reduction among large industrial gas users
segments.tr: - 大規模な産業用ガスユーザーに対する自主的な需要削減の奨励

segments.src: - Coordinating LNG import scheduling between member states to smooth out supply gaps
segments.tr: - 供給ギャップを平準化するための加盟国間でのLNG輸入スケジュールの調整

segments.src: - Monitoring the option of temporary industrial curtailments as a last-resort measure if reserves fall too low during a cold snap
segments.tr: - 寒波の際に備蓄が低下しすぎた場合の最終手段としての、一時的な産業利用制限の選択肢の監視

segments.src: Energy ministers have generally avoided alarmist language, framing the situation as manageable rather than a repeat of the acute crisis seen a few years ago, when Europe scrambled to replace a much larger share of its gas supply almost overnight.
segments.tr: エネルギー担当大臣らは概して警戒を煽るような発言を避け、状況を管理可能であると位置づけている。数年前に欧州がガス供給の大部分をほぼ一夜にして代替しようと奔走した際に経験したような深刻な危機とは異なるという見解だ。

segments.src: Still, the underlying message from market watchers is consistent: the buffer is thinner this year, and the outcome may hinge as much on the weather as on policy.
segments.tr: それでも、市場監視者からの根本的なメッセージは一貫している。今年は緩衝材が薄くなっており、結果は政策と同じくらい天候に左右される可能性があるということだ。

segments.src: ## What It Could Mean for Households and Businesses
segments.tr: ## 家計や企業にとって何を意味するのか

segments.src: For consumers, the most immediate concern is price.
segments.tr: 消費者にとって最も差し迫った懸念は価格である。

segments.src: Tighter storage levels heading into the withdrawal season tend to make wholesale gas markets more sensitive to news, meaning prices can swing more sharply on reports of supply disruptions or cold weather forecasts.
segments.tr: ガス引き出しシーズンに向けて備蓄水準が逼迫していると、卸売ガス市場はニュースに対して敏感になりやすく、供給混乱の報告や寒冷予報によって価格がより急激に変動する可能性がある。

segments.src: Businesses that rely heavily on natural gas — chemical manufacturers, fertilizer producers, and other energy-intensive industries — are watching most closely, since they are typically first in line for any curtailment requests if supply gets tight.
segments.tr: 天然ガスに大きく依存している企業（化学メーカー、肥料生産者、その他のエネルギー集約型産業）は、供給が逼迫した場合に制限要請の対象となる可能性が最も高いため、この状況を最も注視している。

segments.src: Households, meanwhile, are less likely to face direct rationing, as residential heating is usually prioritized in emergency planning across EU member states.
segments.tr: 一方、家庭については、EU加盟国の緊急時計画において住宅用暖房が通常優先されるため、直接的な配給制限に直面する可能性は低い。

segments.src: The bigger risk for ordinary consumers is indirect: higher energy bills passed through from wholesale markets, and potential knock-on effects on goods and services produced by gas-intensive industries.
segments.tr: 一般消費者にとってのより大きなリスクは間接的なものである。卸売市場から転嫁されるエネルギー料金の上昇や、ガス集約型産業が生産する商品やサービスへの波及効果である。

segments.src: ## The Months Ahead
segments.tr: ## 今後の数ヶ月

segments.src: With storage levels below their typical seasonal average, the coming weeks of autumn will be closely watched as a final opportunity to top up reserves before demand rises.
segments.tr: 備蓄水準が季節的な平均を下回っているため、需要が増加する前の最後の補充機会として、秋のこれからの数週間は注意深く監視されることになるだろう。

segments.src: Much will depend on factors outside Europe's direct control — including how tensions around the Strait of Hormuz evolve and whether alternative LNG supplies from other exporting regions can help offset any shortfall.
segments.tr: 多くは欧州の直接的なコントロールが及ばない要因に左右される。ホルムズ海峡周辺の緊張がどう展開するか、また他の輸出地域からの代替LNG供給が不足分を補えるかどうかが鍵となる。

segments.src: For now, the situation is best described as a calculated risk rather than a certain crisis: European officials are wagering that a combination of diversified supply, demand management, and, crucially, favorable weather will be enough to get the continent through winter without resorting to the kind of emergency measures seen in past energy shocks.
segments.tr: 現時点では、この状況は確実な危機というよりは計算されたリスクと表現するのが適切である。欧州当局は、供給の多様化、需要管理、そして何よりも重要な好天の組み合わせによって、過去のエネルギーショックで見られたような緊急措置に頼ることなく、この冬を乗り切れると賭けている。

de.title: Das 17-Jahres-Tief: Warum Europa eilt, seine Gasspeicher vor dem Wintereinbruch zu füllen

segments.src: ## A Storage Squeeze Not Seen in Nearly Two Decades
segments.tr: ## Ein Speicherengpass wie seit fast zwei Jahrzehnten nicht mehr

segments.src: As late summer gives way to autumn, Europe's natural gas storage sites are sitting at their lowest seasonal level in roughly 17 years, according to industry trackers that monitor inventories across the European Union.
segments.tr: Während der Spätsommer dem Herbst weicht, befinden sich Europas Erdgasspeicher nach Angaben von Branchenbeobachtern, die die Bestände in der gesamten Europäischen Union überwachen, auf ihrem niedrigsten saisonalen Stand seit etwa 17 Jahren.

segments.src: For a continent that has spent the past few winters rebuilding confidence in its energy security after the shock of reduced Russian pipeline flows, the shortfall is a reminder that the underlying vulnerabilities in the system have not fully disappeared — they have simply shifted.
segments.tr: Für einen Kontinent, der die letzten Winter damit verbracht hat, nach dem Schock sinkender russischer Pipeline-Lieferungen das Vertrauen in seine Energiesicherheit wiederherzustellen, ist das Defizit eine Mahnung, dass die zugrundeliegenden Schwachstellen im System nicht vollständig verschwunden sind – sie haben sich lediglich verlagert.

segments.src: This year's culprit looks different from the last.
segments.tr: Der Übeltäter dieses Jahres sieht anders aus als der des letzten.

segments.src: Analysts point to disruptions linked to tensions involving Iran, which have complicated tanker traffic through the Strait of Hormuz — the narrow waterway that a large share of the world's liquefied natural gas (LNG), including cargoes from Qatar, must pass through on the way to global markets.
segments.tr: Analysten verweisen auf Störungen im Zusammenhang mit den Spannungen um den Iran, die den Tankerverkehr durch die Straße von Hormus erschwert haben – die schmale Wasserstraße, durch die ein großer Teil des weltweit verflüssigten Erdgases (LNG), einschließlich Ladungen aus Katar, auf dem Weg zu den globalen Märkten passieren muss.

segments.src: When shipments through that chokepoint slow down or reroute, the ripple effects are felt far beyond the Middle East, including in the European ports that have come to rely on LNG as a substitute for pipeline gas.
segments.tr: Wenn sich die Lieferungen durch diesen Engpass verlangsamen oder umgeleitet werden, sind die Welleneffekte weit über den Nahen Osten hinaus spürbar, auch in den europäischen Häfen, die sich auf LNG als Ersatz für Pipeline-Gas verlassen haben.

segments.src: ## Why Storage Levels Matter So Much
segments.tr: ## Warum Speicherstände so wichtig sind

segments.src: Gas storage acts as Europe's shock absorber.
segments.tr: Gasspeicher dienen als Europas Stoßdämpfer.

segments.src: Utilities and industrial buyers inject gas into underground reservoirs during the warmer months, when demand is lower, and draw it down during the cold season when heating needs spike.
segments.tr: Versorger und industrielle Abnehmer pumpen in den wärmeren Monaten, in denen die Nachfrage geringer ist, Gas in unterirdische Lagerstätten und entnehmen es in der kalten Jahreszeit, wenn der Heizbedarf steigt.

segments.src: A healthy storage cushion going into winter gives grid operators room to manage price swings and supply hiccups without resorting to emergency measures.
segments.tr: Ein gesundes Speicherpolster zu Beginn des Winters gibt den Netzbetreibern Spielraum, Preisschwankungen und Versorgungshickhacks zu bewältigen, ohne zu Notmaßnahmen greifen zu müssen.

segments.src: When storage starts the season already depleted, that cushion shrinks.
segments.tr: Wenn die Speicher bereits erschöpft in die Saison starten, schrumpft dieses Polster.

segments.src: Analysts note that a shortfall at this stage of the year does not guarantee a crisis — but it does reduce the margin for error.
segments.tr: Analysten weisen darauf hin, dass ein Defizit zu diesem Zeitpunkt des Jahres keine Krise garantiert – aber es verringert den Spielraum für Fehler.

segments.src: A colder-than-average winter, a further disruption to LNG supply routes, or even a spell of low wind power generation could each add pressure on prices and availability at the same time.
segments.tr: Ein kälter als durchschnittlicher Winter, eine weitere Störung der LNG-Versorgungswege oder auch eine Phase schwacher Windkrafterzeugung könnten jeweils gleichzeitig Druck auf Preise und Verfügbarkeit ausüben.

segments.src: ## Officials Are Betting on Mild Weather
segments.tr: ## Offizielle setzen auf mildes Wetter

segments.src: According to reports from European energy officials, the current strategy leans heavily on hope for a mild winter.
segments.tr: Berichten europäischer Energieverantwortlicher zufolge stützt sich die aktuelle Strategie stark auf die Hoffnung auf einen milden Winter.

segments.src: Government agencies and grid operators across the bloc have reportedly been reviewing contingency plans that include:
segments.tr: Regierungsbehörden und Netzbetreiber im gesamten Block haben Berichten zufolge Notfallpläne überprüft, die Folgendes beinhalten:

segments.src: - Encouraging voluntary demand reduction among large industrial gas users
segments.tr: - Förderung einer freiwilligen Nachfraduzierung bei großen industriellen Gasverbrauchern

segments.src: - Coordinating LNG import scheduling between member states to smooth out supply gaps
segments.tr: - Koordinierung der LNG-Importplanung zwischen den Mitgliedstaaten zur Glättung von Versorgungslücken

segments.src: - Monitoring the option of temporary industrial curtailments as a last-resort measure if reserves fall too low during a cold snap
segments.tr: - Überwachung der Option temporärer industrieller Drosselungen als letzte Maßnahme, falls die Reserven während eines Kälteeinbruchs zu stark sinken

segments.src: Energy ministers have generally avoided alarmist language, framing the situation as manageable rather than a repeat of the acute crisis seen a few years ago, when Europe scrambled to replace a much larger share of its gas supply almost overnight.
segments.tr: Energieminister haben alarmierende Sprache im Allgemeinen vermieden und die Situation als handhabbar dargestellt statt als Wiederholung der akuten Krise vor einigen Jahren, als Europa darum kämpfte, einen viel größeren Anteil seiner Gasversorgung fast über Nacht zu ersetzen.

segments.src: Still, the underlying message from market watchers is consistent: the buffer is thinner this year, and the outcome may hinge as much on the weather as on policy.
segments.tr: Dennoch ist die Kernbotschaft der Marktbeobachter konsistent: Der Puffer ist in diesem Jahr dünner, und das Ergebnis hängt möglicherweise ebenso sehr vom Wetter wie von der Politik ab.

segments.src: ## What It Could Mean for Households and Businesses
segments.tr: ## Was das für Haushalte und Unternehmen bedeuten könnte

segments.src: For consumers, the most immediate concern is price.
segments.tr: Für die Verbraucher ist der Preis die unmittelbarste Sorge.

segments.src: Tighter storage levels heading into the withdrawal season tend to make wholesale gas markets more sensitive to news, meaning prices can swing more sharply on reports of supply disruptions or cold weather forecasts.
segments.tr: Engere Speicherstände zu Beginn der Entnahmesaison neigen dazu, die Großhandelsmärkte für Gas empfindlicher auf Nachrichten reagieren zu lassen, was bedeutet, dass die Preise bei Berichten über Lieferunterbrechungen oder Kältevorhersagen stärker schwanken können.

segments.src: Businesses that rely heavily on natural gas — chemical manufacturers, fertilizer producers, and other energy-intensive industries — are watching most closely, since they are typically first in line for any curtailment requests if supply gets tight.
segments.tr: Unternehmen, die stark von Erdgas abhängig sind – Chemiehersteller, Düngemittelproduzenten und andere energieintensive Industrien –, beobachten dies am genauesten, da sie im Falle von Versorgungsengpässen typischerweise als Erste für Drosselungsanfragen infrage kommen.

segments.src: Households, meanwhile, are less likely to face direct rationing, as residential heating is usually prioritized in emergency planning across EU member states.
segments.tr: Haushalte hingegen sind weniger wahrscheinlich von direkten Rationierungen betroffen, da das Heizen von Wohnungen in der Notfallplanung der EU-Mitgliedstaaten in der Regel priorisiert wird.

segments.src: The bigger risk for ordinary consumers is indirect: higher energy bills passed through from wholesale markets, and potential knock-on effects on goods and services produced by gas-intensive industries.
segments.tr: Das größere Risiko für normale Verbraucher ist indirekt: höhere Energierechnungen, die von den Großhandelsmärkten weitergegeben werden, und mögliche Folgewirkungen auf Waren und Dienstleistungen, die von gasintensiven Industrien produziert werden.

segments.src: ## The Months Ahead
segments.tr: ## Die kommenden Monate

segments.src: With storage levels below their typical seasonal average, the coming weeks of autumn will be closely watched as a final opportunity to top up reserves before demand rises.
segments.tr: Da die Speicherstände unter ihrem typischen saisonalen Durchschnitt liegen, werden die kommenden Herbstwochen als letzte Gelegenheit genau beobachtet, die Reserven aufzufüllen, bevor die Nachfrage steigt.

segments.src: Much will depend on factors outside Europe's direct control — including how tensions around the Strait of Hormuz evolve and whether alternative LNG supplies from other exporting regions can help offset any shortfall.
segments.tr: Vieles wird von Faktoren abhängen, die außerhalb von Europas direkter Kontrolle liegen – einschließlich der Entwicklung der Spannungen um die Straße von Hormus und der Frage, ob alternative LNG-Lieferungen aus anderen Exportregionen helfen können, ein Defizit auszugleichen.

segments.src: For now, the situation is best described as a calculated risk rather than a certain crisis: European officials are wagering that a combination of diversified supply, demand management, and, crucially, favorable weather will be enough to get the continent through winter without resorting to the kind of emergency measures seen in past energy shocks.
segments.tr: Derzeit lässt sich die Situation am besten als kalkuliertes Risiko denn als sichere Krise beschreiben: Europäische Amtsträger wetten darauf, dass eine Kombination aus diversifizierter Versorgung, Nachfragemanagement und, entscheidend, günstigem Wetter ausreichen wird, um den Kontinent durch den Winter zu bringen, ohne zu den Notmaßnahmen greifen zu müssen, die bei vergangenen Energieschocks beobachtet wurden.

vi.title: Mức thấp nhất trong 17 năm: Lý do châu Âu đang chạy đua để lấp đầy các kho dự trữ khí đốt trước khi mùa đông đến

segments.src: ## A Storage Squeeze Not Seen in Nearly Two Decades
segments.tr: ## Sự thiếu hụt kho chứa chưa từng thấy trong gần hai thập kỷ

segments.src: As late summer gives way to autumn, Europe's natural gas storage sites are sitting at their lowest seasonal level in roughly 17 years, according to industry trackers that monitor inventories across the European Union.
segments.tr: Khi mùa hè muộn nhường chỗ cho mùa thu, các cơ sở lưu trữ khí đốt tự nhiên của châu Âu đang ở mức thấp nhất theo mùa trong khoảng 17 năm, theo các đơn vị theo dõi ngành giám sát lượng tồn kho trên toàn Liên minh Châu Âu.

segments.src: For a continent that has spent the past few winters rebuilding confidence in its energy security after the shock of reduced Russian pipeline flows, the shortfall is a reminder that the underlying vulnerabilities in the system have not fully disappeared — they have simply shifted.
segments.tr: Đối với một lục địa đã dành vài mùa đông qua để khôi phục niềm tin vào an ninh năng lượng sau cú sốc do dòng chảy đường ống của Nga giảm, sự thiếu hụt là lời nhắc nhở rằng những điểm dễ bị tổn thương cơ bản trong hệ thống chưa hoàn toàn biến mất — chúng chỉ đơn giản là chuyển dịch.

segments.src: This year's culprit looks different from the last.
segments.tr: Thủ phạm của năm nay có vẻ khác so với năm ngoái.

segments.src: Analysts point to disruptions linked to tensions involving Iran, which have complicated tanker traffic through the Strait of Hormuz — the narrow waterway that a large share of the world's liquefied natural gas (LNG), including cargoes from Qatar, must pass through on the way to global markets.
segments.tr: Các nhà phân tích chỉ ra các gián đoạn liên quan đến căng thẳng có dính líu đến Iran, điều này đã làm phức tạp giao thông tàu chở dầu qua Eo biển Hormuz — tuyến đường thủy hẹp mà phần lớn khí tự nhiên hóa lỏng (LNG) của thế giới, bao gồm cả các lô hàng từ Qatar, phải đi qua trên đường tới các thị trường toàn cầu.

segments.src: When shipments through that chokepoint slow down or reroute, the ripple effects are felt far beyond the Middle East, including in the European ports that have come to rely on LNG as a substitute for pipeline gas.
segments.tr: Khi các chuyến hàng qua điểm nghẽn đó chậm lại hoặc chuyển hướng, hiệu ứng gợn sóng sẽ được cảm nhận rất xa ngoài Trung Đông, bao gồm cả ở các cảng của châu Âu vốn đã phụ thuộc vào LNG như một chất thay thế cho khí đốt qua đường ống.

segments.src: ## Why Storage Levels Matter So Much
segments.tr: ## Tại sao mức dự trữ lại quan trọng đến vậy

segments.src: Gas storage acts as Europe's shock absorber.
segments.tr: Kho dự trữ khí đốt đóng vai trò là bộ giảm xóc của châu Âu.

segments.src: Utilities and industrial buyers inject gas into underground reservoirs during the warmer months, when demand is lower, and draw it down during the cold season when heating needs spike.
segments.tr: Các công ty tiện ích và người mua công nghiệp bơm khí vào các bể chứa ngầm trong những tháng ấm hơn, khi nhu cầu thấp hơn, và rút ra trong mùa lạnh khi nhu cầu sưởi ấm tăng vọt.

segments.src: A healthy storage cushion going into winter gives grid operators room to manage price swings and supply hiccups without resorting to emergency measures.
segments.tr: Một đệm dự trữ lành mạnh bước vào mùa đông giúp các nhà điều hành lưới điện có không gian để quản lý biến động giá và các sự cố cung ứng mà không phải nhờ đến các biện pháp khẩn cấp.

segments.src: When storage starts the season already depleted, that cushion shrinks.
segments.tr: Khi kho dự trữ bắt đầu mùa đã cạn kiệt, lớp đệm đó sẽ thu lại.

segments.src: Analysts note that a shortfall at this stage of the year does not guarantee a crisis — but it does reduce the margin for error.
segments.tr: Các nhà phân tích lưu ý rằng sự thiếu hụt ở giai đoạn này trong năm không đảm bảo xảy ra khủng hoảng — nhưng nó làm giảm biên độ sai sót.

segments.src: A colder-than-average winter, a further disruption to LNG supply routes, or even a spell of low wind power generation could each add pressure on prices and availability at the same time.
segments.tr: Một mùa đông lạnh hơn mức trung bình, sự gián đoạn tiếp theo đối với các tuyến cung cấp LNG, hoặc thậm chí một giai đoạn phát điện gió thấp đều có thể gia tăng áp lực lên giá cả và khả năng sẵn có cùng một lúc.

segments.src: ## Officials Are Betting on Mild Weather
segments.tr: ## Các quan chức đang đặt cược vào thời tiết ôn hòa

segments.src: According to reports from European energy officials, the current strategy leans heavily on hope for a mild winter.
segments.tr: Theo các báo cáo từ các quan chức năng lượng châu Âu, chiến lược hiện tại dựa nhiều vào hy vọng về một mùa đông ôn hòa.

segments.src: Government agencies and grid operators across the bloc have reportedly been reviewing contingency plans that include:
segments.tr: Các cơ quan chính phủ và nhà điều hành lưới điện trên toàn khối được cho là đã xem xét các kế hoạch dự phòng bao gồm:

segments.src: - Encouraging voluntary demand reduction among large industrial gas users
segments.tr: - Khuyến khích giảm nhu cầu tự nguyện trong số những người tiêu dùng khí đốt công nghiệp lớn

segments.src: - Coordinating LNG import scheduling between member states to smooth out supply gaps
segments.tr: - Phối hợp lập lịch nhập khẩu LNG giữa các quốc gia thành viên để làm phẳng các khoảng trống nguồn cung

segments.src: - Monitoring the option of temporary industrial curtailments as a last-resort measure if reserves fall too low during a cold snap
segments.tr: - Theo dõi tùy chọn cắt giảm công nghiệp tạm thời như một biện pháp cuối cùng nếu dự trữ giảm quá thấp trong đợt rét đậm

segments.src: Energy ministers have generally avoided alarmist language, framing the situation as manageable rather than a repeat of the acute crisis seen a few years ago, when Europe scrambled to replace a much larger share of its gas supply almost overnight.
segments.tr: Các bộ trưởng năng lượng nhìn chung đã tránh ngôn từ gây hoang mang, định hình tìnhการณ์ là có thể quản lý được thay vì lặp lại cuộc khủng hoảng trầm trọng đã thấy vài năm trước, khi châu Âu chật vật thay thế phần lớn hơn nhiều trong nguồn cung khí đốt của mình gần như chỉ sau một đêm.

segments.src: Still, the underlying message from market watchers is consistent: the buffer is thinner this year, and the outcome may hinge as much on the weather as on policy.
segments.tr: Tuy nhiên, thông điệp cơ bản từ những người theo dõi thị trường là nhất quán: bộ đệm năm nay mỏng hơn, và kết quả có thể phụ thuộc vào thời tiết nhiều như vào chính sách.

segments.src: ## What It Could Mean for Households and Businesses
segments.tr: ## Ý nghĩa của nó đối với các hộ gia đình và doanh nghiệp

segments.src: For consumers, the most immediate concern is price.
segments.tr: Đối với người tiêu dùng, mối quan tâm trước mắt nhất là giá cả.

segments.src: Tighter storage levels heading into the withdrawal season tend to make wholesale gas markets more sensitive to news, meaning prices can swing more sharply on reports of supply disruptions or cold weather forecasts.
segments.tr: Mức dự trữ thắt chặt hơn tiến vào mùa rút khí có xu hướng làm cho thị trường khí đốt bán buôn nhạy cảm hơn với tin tức, có nghĩa là giá có thể dao động mạnh hơn dựa trên các báo cáo về gián đoạn nguồn cung hoặc dự báo thời tiết lạnh.

segments.src: Businesses that rely heavily on natural gas — chemical manufacturers, fertilizer producers, and other energy-intensive industries — are watching most closely, since they are typically first in line for any curtailment requests if supply gets tight.
segments.tr: Các doanh nghiệp phụ thuộc nhiều vào khí đốt tự nhiên — nhà sản xuất hóa chất, nhà sản xuất phân bón và các ngành công nghiệp tiêu thụ nhiều năng lượng khác — đang theo dõi sát sao nhất, vì họ thường là những người đầu tiên xếp hàng cho bất kỳ yêu cầu cắt giảm nào nếu nguồn cung trở nên khan hiếm.

segments.src: Households, meanwhile, are less likely to face direct rationing, as residential heating is usually prioritized in emergency planning across EU member states.
segments.tr: Trong khi đó, các hộ gia đình ít có khả năng đối mặt với việc phân phối trực tiếp hơn, vì việc sưởi ấm khu dân cư thường được ưu tiên trong lập kế hoạch khẩn cấp trên khắp các quốc gia thành viên EU.

segments.src: The bigger risk for ordinary consumers is indirect: higher energy bills passed through from wholesale markets, and potential knock-on effects on goods and services produced by gas-intensive industries.
segments.tr: Rủi ro lớn hơn đối với người tiêu dùng thông thường là gián tiếp: hóa đơn năng lượng cao hơn được chuyển từ thị trường bán buôn, và các tác động lan truyền tiềm ẩn đối với hàng hóa và dịch vụ được sản xuất bởi các ngành công nghiệp tiêu thụ nhiều khí đốt.

segments.src: ## The Months Ahead
segments.tr: ## Những tháng tới

segments.src: With storage levels below their typical seasonal average, the coming weeks of autumn will be closely watched as a final opportunity to top up reserves before demand rises.
segments.tr: Với mức dự trữ dưới mức trung bình theo mùa thông thường, những tuần tới của mùa thu sẽ được theo dõi chặt chẽ như cơ hội cuối cùng để bổ sung dự trữ trước khi nhu cầu tăng lên.

segments.src: Much will depend on factors outside Europe's direct control — including how tensions around the Strait of Hormuz evolve and whether alternative LNG supplies from other exporting regions can help offset any shortfall.
segments.tr: Phần lớn sẽ phụ thuộc vào các yếu tố nằm ngoài tầm kiểm soát trực tiếp của châu Âu — bao gồm cả cách thức căng thẳng xung quanh Eo biển Hormuz diễn biến và liệu các nguồn cung cấp LNG thay thế từ các khu vực xuất khẩu khác có thể giúp bù đắp bất kỳ sự thiếu hụt nào hay không.

segments.src: For now, the situation is best described as a calculated risk rather than a certain crisis: European officials are wagering that a combination of diversified supply, demand management, and, crucially, favorable weather will be enough to get the continent through winter without resorting to the kind of emergency measures seen in past energy shocks.
segments.tr: Hiện tại, tình hình được mô tả tốt nhất là một rủi ro được tính toán chứ không phải là một cuộc khủng hoảng chắc chắn: các quan chức châu Âu đang đánh cược rằng sự kết hợp giữa nguồn cung đa dạng hóa, quản lý nhu cầu và quan trọng nhất là thời tiết thuận lợi sẽ đủ để đưa lục địa vượt qua mùa đông mà không cần dùng đến các biện pháp khẩn cấp từng thấy trong các cú sốc năng lượng trước đây.
